option_relations.rationale: Acute Intestinal Obstruction is a broad category that can encompass various causes, including internal hernias which are a type of intestinal obstruction.
Intestinal ischemia can be a serious complication of intestinal obstruction, including that caused by an internal hernia.

Gastric band erosion with migration to jejunum causing intestinal obstruction and jejunal perforation describes a specific etiology and complication not directly related to an internal hernia, although both can cause obstruction.

Small Bowel Obstruction (Post-bariatric Surgery Adhesion/Stricture) is a type of small bowel obstruction that can occur after bariatric surgery. An internal hernia (e.g., Petersen or mesenteric defect) after bariatric surgery is a specific cause of small bowel obstruction in this context.
